scope: Existing saved reading detail GET selection lifecycle, not archive-list/map/chat/daily changes
checks: loaded A is hidden during B pending, HTTP failure and retry
A to B to A ignores the first same-ID response while the fresh A is pending
late previous network failure cannot end B loading or overwrite B error
late response.json success after route change is discarded
late response.json failure cannot display an old error over B
revisiting failed A after another target clears its old error before the fresh request
current malformed JSON and response-shape failures stay retryable without previous A
unmount aborts pending details and ignores late body success and failure
Strict Mode discarded mount cannot finish the active detail request
limits: Real SavedPage, FortuneCard, response reader and pinned calculation code in JSDOM
Header and chat UI excluded; API/router boundaries deliberately deferred and synthetic
No source mutations or live requests
No production data, auth, external calls, browser visuals or physical-device checks
